channel.title: The Grant Desk - Tech & Infrastructure, weekly digest
channel.description: Paid open calls, fellowships and residencies in AI, tech, research, and digital and mixed-media arts, sorted into the right pile. Updated as new calls land on the desk. Filtered to: Tech & Infrastructure, weekly digest. Released weekly: the week's new grants arrive together on Sunday, one entry per grant plus a short roundup header, instead of trickling out daily.

item.title: 7 new Tech & Infrastructure grants - week of 24 Aug 2026
item.description:
• Video Pool: Media Art + Technology Residency (MATR) 2027
    https://videopool.org/media-arts-technology-residency-2027-call-for-applications/
    Video Pool Media Arts Centre · deadline Closed 30 Aug 2026 · CAD 2,250 artist fee, covering both the residency period and the subsequent Poolside Gallery exhibition. Residents also get full access to VP's equipment, facilities and technical resources; the Poolside Gallery itself is equipped with two projectors and four speakers. Applicants must be VP members, so a membership is purchased separately, but there is no separate application fee.
  • Human Rights Watch: AI Strategy and Solutions Lead (one-year fixed term)
    https://job-boards.greenhouse.io/humanrightswatch/jobs/8350654002
    Human Rights Watch (HRW), Operations Department · deadline Closed 30 Aug 2026 · USD 102,000 to 112,000 plus employer-paid benefits if based in the US; ranges outside the US are set by local market conditions. No application fee.
  • Residing Non-linear Technologies and Sonic Worldings (M-Cult x Titanik, Helsinki and Turku)
    https://www.titanik.fi/residency-open-call-residing-non-linear-technologies-and-sonic-worldings/
    Art and Media Culture Agency M-Cult (Helsinki) and Arte artists' association / Titanik gallery (Turku) · deadline Closed 30 Aug 2026 · EUR 3,500 artist fee plus EUR 2,000 production budget, two months' accommodation split between Helsinki and Turku, and one return travel ticket from a Nordic-Baltic country. No application fee stated.
  • Sphera Media Lab 2026: Open Call for Masterclasses and Keynotes
    https://arty-farty.typeform.com/to/xnDikGGM
    European Lab (Arty Farty) and the Sphera Network, coordinated by Medianes · deadline Closed 31 Aug 2026 · Selected contributors receive a fee plus travel to Brussels and accommodation, all covered by the organisers. The fee amount is not published in the call. No submission fee.
  • ESA Open Space Innovation Platform (OSIP): rolling open call for ideas
    https://www.esa.int/Enabling_Support/Preparing_for_the_Future/Discovery_and_Preparation/The_Open_Space_Innovation_Platform_OSIP
    European Space Agency (ESA) · deadline Rolling / undated · Varies by route and campaign. Successful ideas are supported through PhD or postdoctoral research co-funded by ESA and universities, early technology development activities, or system studies. Free to submit.
  • Digital Defenders Partnership: Incident Response Fund
    https://www.digitaldefenders.org/funds/
    Digital Defenders Partnership (DDP), hosted by Hivos · deadline Rolling / undated · Rapid-response grants of up to USD 5,000 (historically up to EUR 10,000) for costs that directly reduce the risk or impact of a digital attack, covering activities for a maximum of four months. No application fee.
  • CSET (Georgetown): Frontier AI Research Lead (Research Fellow or Senior Fellow)
    https://cset.georgetown.edu/job/frontier-ai-research-lead/
    Center for Security and Emerging Technology (CSET), Georgetown University Walsh School of Foreign Service · deadline Rolling / undated · Research Fellow: roughly USD 100,000 to 130,000 per year. Senior Fellow: roughly USD 160,000 to 190,000 per year. Commensurate with experience. Georgetown University benefits. No application fee.

Full listing with filters: The Grant Desk (https://www.artificialnouveau.com/smalltools/grants/).

item.title: 5 new Tech & Infrastructure grants - week of 17 Aug 2026
item.description:

  • University of East Anglia: Deputy Dean, CUCN-UEA Digital Creativity Institute
    https://vacancies.uea.ac.uk/vacancies/vacancy-search-results.aspx
    University of East Anglia (UEA), Faculty of Arts and Humanities · deadline Closed 31 Aug 2026 · GBP 69,488 to 73,709 per annum depending on qualifications and experience, plus the standard UEA pension and leave package. No application fee.
  • KNOWCASE Open Call 2027: permanent digital-culture installation in Madrid (Sonar+D x Fundacion Cotec)
    https://sonar.es/en/news/knowcase-open-call-2027
    Fundacion Cotec and Sonar+D · deadline 07 Sep 2026 · Up to EUR 100,000 (plus VAT), all-inclusive: conceptualisation, design, technical development, production, installation, maintenance, documentation, artist fees, travel, accommodation and insurance.
  • Cultuurloket DigitALL: Implementation Contribution (Implementatiebijdrage, 2026)
    https://cultuurloketdigitall.nl/implementatiebijdrage/
    Cultuurloket DigitALL · deadline 01 Nov 2026 · Up to EUR 30,000. Covers technical modification, system integration, production and deployment costs. Hardware purchase alone is ineligible unless clearly essential to the public experience. No stated co-financing percentage. No application fee.
  • Cultuurloket DigitALL: Pilot Contribution (Pilotbijdrage, 2026-2027, rolling)
    https://cultuurloketdigitall.nl/pilotbijdrage/
    Cultuurloket DigitALL (successor to Kickstart Cultuurfonds) · deadline Rolling / undated · Up to EUR 75,000. Covers pilot development, audience testing, and knowledge development or training via partner organisations if budgeted. Hardware-only purchases are not eligible. No stated co-financing percentage. No application fee. Annual donation budget of EUR 1.9 million in 2026 and 2027.

item.title: 4 new Tech & Infrastructure grants - week of 10 Aug 2026
item.description:
• University of Twente: Postdoc, Multimodal Conversational AI for Cultural Heritage
    https://www.academictransfer.com/en/jobs/362707/postdoc-position-on-multimodal-conversational-ai-for-cultural-heritage/
    University of Twente, Human Media Interaction group · deadline Closed 16 Aug 2026 · EUR 3,546 to 5,538 gross per month for 40 hours per week (8 salary steps, depending on experience), plus standard Dutch university holiday and year-end allowances.
  • transmediale x Pro Helvetia Digital Art Residency 2027
    https://transmediale.de/en/news/digital-art-residency-2027
    transmediale (in cooperation with the Swiss Arts Council Pro Helvetia) · deadline Closed 28 Aug 2026 · Artist fee of CHF 2,000 per month across the two-month residency (CHF 4,000), plus a production grant of CHF 15,000 for the selected project, plus travel and accommodation for both the festival and the residency month. Duos and collectives may apply but the fee and the production grant stay the same and must be shared. No application fee.
  • Wilson Center Research Fellowship, 2027-2028 Class
    https://www.wilsoncenter.org/research-fellowship
    Woodrow Wilson International Center for Scholars · deadline 30 Sep 2026 · USD 10,000 per month for a twelve-month fellowship, plus covered travel for the two required trips to Washington DC. No application fee.
  • Science & Technology Policy Fellowships, 2027-28 Class
    https://www.aaas.org/programs/science-technology-policy-fellowships
    American Association for the Advancement of Science (AAAS) · deadline 01 Nov 2026 · Stipend depending on experience and placement, roughly USD 85,000 to 140,000; the dedicated AI legislative branch cohort is paid at GS-12 Step 10 on the DC locality scale. Includes health insurance, a travel and professional development allowance, and relocation support for some placements. No application fee.

item.title: 3 new Tech & Infrastructure grants - week of 03 Aug 2026
item.description:
• Innovate UK: Next Wave Breakthrough Wave 1, Createch (2026)
    https://apply-for-innovation-funding.service.gov.uk/competition/2517/overview/6ff2066d-4639-44e6-bb4f-ce7099222739
    Innovate UK, UK Research and Innovation · deadline Closed 11 Aug 2026 · GBP 100,000 to 500,000 total project costs from a GBP 10 million fund; no organisation may receive more than GBP 3 million across the programme. Grant intervention rates for industrial research: up to 70 percent for micro and small enterprises, 60 percent for medium, 50 percent for large. Research organisations doing non-economic work can claim up to 100 percent, or 80 percent of full economic cost for academic institutions. The balance is match funding. No application fee.
  • Kennan Institute Digital Fellowship 2026-2027
    https://www.kennaninstitute.org/digital-fellowship
    Kennan Institute, Woodrow Wilson International Center for Scholars (supported by the Lounsbery Foundation and the U.S. Russia Foundation) · deadline Closed 14 Aug 2026 · USD 2,000 monthly stipend for the six-month programme, plus mentorship from the Kennan community of experts, six virtual webinars tailored to the cohort, and inclusion in the Kennan alumni network of over 4,500 people. Travel and visa costs are explicitly not covered. No application fee.
  • Horizon Fellowship, 2027 Cohort
    https://horizonpublicservice.org/programs/become-a-fellow/
    Horizon Institute for Public Service · deadline Closed 30 Aug 2026 · Base salary of USD 78,000 for junior fellows, USD 130,000 for fellows, and USD 190,000 or more for senior fellows, plus a USD 17,000 benefits stipend, a USD 3,000 professional development stipend, and up to USD 3,000 relocation assistance. No application fee.

Full listing with filters: The Grant Desk (https://www.artificialnouveau.com/smalltools/grants/).

item.title: 3 new Tech & Infrastructure grants - week of 15 Jun 2026
item.description:
• Eurostars Call 11 2026 (Eureka / Eurostars-3)
    https://www.eurekanetwork.org/programmes-and-calls/eurostars/eurostars-call-for-projects-september-2026/
    Eureka / Eurostars-3 (Dutch participation via RVO) · deadline 10 Sep 2026 · Co-funds collaborative international R&D; national funding varies by country. For the Dutch project share: up to EUR 500,000 per project at 50 percent reimbursement of eligible R&D costs. No application fee.
  • MIT R&D Collaboration Projects 2026 (MKB Innovatiestimulering Topsectoren)
    https://www.rvo.nl/subsidies-financiering/mit/rd-samenwerkingsprojecten
    Rijksdienst voor Ondernemend Nederland (RVO) · deadline 15 Sep 2026 · Grant covering 35 percent of eligible costs. Small projects EUR 50,000-200,000; large projects EUR 200,000-350,000 per project (EUR 25,000-100,000 or EUR 25,000-175,000 per participant). No application fee.
  • WBSO: R&D Tax Credit (rolling, Netherlands)
    https://english.rvo.nl/subsidies-financing/wbso
    Rijksdienst voor Ondernemend Nederland (RVO) · deadline Rolling / undated · Payroll/income tax reduction for R&D, not a cash grant. 2026: 36 percent of the first EUR 380,000 of R&D wage costs (50 percent for startups), 16 percent above; fixed deduction for self-employed. National budget EUR 1.817 billion for 2026. No application fee.
